The '''Mission to Lotide''' was undertaken by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] who infiltrated an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lotide]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the mission, the Rebels gained valuable intelligence that would eventually help them to capture the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''.
